full_page.content:
1928, June
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 4.
Page 26 June 13 Vida Karner
Mrs. Lesperance - 63 - 511 Lakewood, broke hip 3 yrs ago. It refuses to knit ..... Has one daughter ... fearing tuberculosis.
Wm. Gearhart 33 (6685 Field) 11 operations since Dec. 13th in Ford Hosp. now 7 weeks
Ed McGrath's boy .... O'Connor - Cancer ..... beautiful death Riske boy - blind - 6 yrs. - Non C.
Page 27 June 27 Henry J. Wiggle (56), 5020 Origon Ave. - Told at Ann Arbor that he'd never step on his foot again - gangreen diabetis - now work- int every day - since 3 mo. after Enrollment.
Wall case - Wiggle Case - McDonald Case ---- July 4th
Nellie Devlin (50-) Vanished Feb. 8, no trace has been yet found of her.
June 2 Mrs. Anna Foster (42) Widow in St. Joseph's Retreat - Mother of two children who stay with Grandmother ..... Pray for her.
Poor little Genevieve Hurley - Bay City - still helpless. 17-yr .- Young girl missing since Sunday
Page 28 July 11th 5th Baby Jerome C. Kipp. ( 14month) of Carson City - weak back - Epyleplic
Lee Kent (Undertaker) cured
Mr. LaRue gone since Monday A.M. - discouraged - leaves note - not returing. Sister Stephen's Threatened Vocation Mrs. Rabideau's Friend cured
